The text confirms that the IR generated by Dr.Jit is then processed by these backends.

*   **Limitations:** The optimization strategy relies on tracing every instance, which can increase compilation time if deduplication is not effective [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the system 'trace[s] every reachable instance' of polymorphic functions (like ubershader materials) without making assumptions. It further notes that this process 'generates many identical functions that can then be safely merged' (deduplication). The text also mentions that 'subroutine deduplication... reverts most of the growth in compilation time,' implying that without effective deduplication, the tracing process leads to increased compilation time. Thus, the claim that the strategy relies on tracing every instance and that this can increase compilation time if deduplication is not effective is fully supported by the text.
